sites.title: Sites
sites.intro: Every domain this server answers for.
sites.new.title: New site
sites.new.hint: Creates a site with no files: for a site made of proxy routes, or to set one up before its first deploy. To publish files, [deploy a zip](deployUrl) instead. That creates the site too.
sites.new.createdAdmin: {domain} was created with no files. Add proxy routes here, or deploy a zip to it.
sites.new.createdMember: {domain} was created with no files. Deploy a zip to it, or ask an administrator to add proxy routes.
sites.empty: There are no sites yet. [Deploy your first site](deployUrl), or create one above.
sites.error.domainInvalid: That is not a valid domain name.
sites.error.domainLong: Domain names must be 253 characters or fewer.
sites.error.domainPartLength: Each part of a domain name must be between 1 and 63 characters.
sites.error.domainHyphen: Parts of a domain name cannot start or end with a hyphen.
sites.error.domainCharacters: Domain names may only contain letters, digits, hyphens and dots.
sites.error.exists: A site is already published at '{domain}'.
sites.error.reserved: '{domain}' is reserved for the management interface.
sites.error.renameSame: The site is already published at '{domain}'.
sites.error.leftoverFiles: '{domain}' still has files on disk from an earlier site. Remove {path} and try again.
sites.error.moveFailed: The site's files could not be moved. Nothing was changed.
sites.error.nameIsAlias: '{name}' is a domain of {site}. Remove it from that site's other domains first.
sites.error.nameUnderWildcard: '{name}' is answered by {site}, through its other domain {wildcard}. Only an administrator can give it a site of its own.
sites.error.aliasInvalid: '{value}' is not a domain, or `*.` followed by one: {error}
sites.error.aliasTooBroad: '{value}' is too broad. A wildcard needs a domain of two parts or more after `*.`, such as `*.example.com`.
sites.error.aliasOtherSite: '{alias}' is the domain of another site.
sites.error.aliasManagement: '{alias}' is reserved for the management interface.
sites.error.aliasTakesManagement: '{alias}' would take {host}, where this management app is open, because no management hosts are set. Set `SiteHosting:ManagementHosts` first.
sites.error.aliasTooMany: A site can have at most {max} other domains, and this list has {count}. A wildcard such as `*.example.com` answers many names at once.
